name: nevo-specdev
description: Workspace root for Nevo SpecDev — a spec-driven development framework for AI-assisted software engineering.

scripts.check:quality: pnpm quality:build-tools && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm docs:check && pnpm version:check-transition
scripts.check: pnpm check:quality && turbo run typecheck test build
scripts.product:pack: pnpm --filter nevo-repo-product build && node tools/product/dist/bin.js pack
scripts.dogfood:install: pnpm --filter nevo-repo-product build && node tools/product/dist/bin.js dogfood
